boundary.description: From Smithies Bridge on the A59 N by the River Ribble N to Skirden Beck to Grunsagill OS782543 N by the Ribble Valley - Craven Civil boundary to Tosside OS770560 N then W to Ravens Castle or Crowd Stones on Great Harlow Fell OS694613 W and S by the Ribble Valley - Lancaster Civil boundary over Hawthorntwaite Fell to the Ribble Valley - Wyre Civil boundary OS575505 SE to the cairn on Fair Snape Fell W by the Civil boundary with Bowland-with-Leagram to Burholme Bridge OS657479 S by the River Hodder to River Ribble N by the Ribble to its confluence with Smithies Brook and to Smithies Bridge on the A59.
